title: Totem Counter++
description: A complete functional totem counter, that deletes pop count on opponent death, your death, and server join/rejoin! Pop count shows in leaderboard and nametags.
body:
# Totem Counter++

Totem Counter++ Is the BEST totem counter mod out currently.

**IT INCLUDES**
- Detection of how many times your opponent has popped a totem
- Detection of how many totems you have left
- Detection of how many times you have popped a totem
  
# Quality Of Life
Totem Counter++ Main features that distinguishes it against currently existing totem counters mod is the nametag + leaderboard pop logs. 
It also is the best totem counter mod as on your death, opponents death, and server change the pop count is reset. This means that if your dueling someone a bunch in a row, you **dont have to clear your totem pops each round.**

# In Game

Here, You can see in image of the leaderboard. This is showcasing a suffix of | (totem pops) so you are able to see the amount of totem pops someone has if you hold tab.
![Suffix Showcase in Leaderboard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65b10b2e77fd8446ffd82594be6d8d30fc655f27.png)

Here, you  can see an image of a users nametag. This is showcasing a suffix of | (totem pops) so you can see the  amount of totem pops mid pvp without having to hold tab
![Player List Pop Count](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad094a6ffac430bb2a8c756da25222307bc1581d_0.webp)

Lastly, You can  see your own totems Left + the amount of totems you popped

As you can see here, When I hold tab I see how many times I popped, and how many times my opponent has popped.
![Both Player Pop Count](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7182e5652578c71c38540d8ff53f895ebccb900_0.webp)

Here, You can see a totem amount above your hotbar that showcases how many totems you have left. Shown by a simple Totems: (number of totems left)
![Totems left in inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e1fa7a35f611f2a1a467bd9c7a93280fdbdded2.png)
